column1: # Licence texts for first-party packages that ship without a copyright file.
# /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright for every installed package named here.
# Each text under texts/ is a verbatim copy of <path> in <source> at <commit>,
# pinned by sha256; tools/verify-licence-notices.sh re-fetches and compares them.
# The build fails when an installed package version differs from <version>, a
# text is missing or changed, or the package now ships its own copyright file.
# A row whose <path>, <text> and <sha256> are "-" records a component whose
# source has no licence file at that commit: the copyright file says so and
# A #L<start>-L<end> suffix pins an inclusive source line range.
# Columns (tab-separated): package version component source commit path text sha256
